worldcombat.skill.sleeppowder.summary: Throws soporific powder that lands and spreads into a long-lasting dust cloud: foes standing in it are fed drowsiness dose by dose — slowed first, then asleep once they have had enough — while anyone who walks out keeps the drowsiness until it fades. It can seal a path or drive foes into it, and Grass types pass straight through the powder.
worldcombat.skill.sleeppowder.use.0: Seal a corridor, a doorway or a retreat
worldcombat.skill.sleeppowder.use.1: Herd pursuers into the cloud and let them drop
worldcombat.skill.sleeppowder.use.2: Create a sleep zone for an ally's Dream Eater or Nightmare
worldcombat.skill.sleeppowder.descriptio: Throws the puff to a point within %1$s (speed %2$s); it spreads into a cloud of radius %3$s on landing — the ring is both the indicator and the real radius.

The cloud lasts %1$s; a foe inside takes a dose every %3$s and needs %2$s doses to fall asleep; stepping out only stops further doses, and the slowness already on the target runs its course. The cloud is anchored to its caster and disperses when they leave or are withdrawn. Grass types pass through the powder.
Once asleep the target sleeps up to %1$s: it cannot act or move, and any damage wakes it at once; drowsiness slows it, each dose lasting %2$s and deepening the more it takes.
worldcombat.skill.sleeppowder.thick.on: Thick cloud: radius ×0.8, duration ×1.25, sleep ×1.25 and one fewer dose needed, at the cost of cooldown ×1.15.
worldcombat.skill.sleeppowder.thick.off: Thin cloud: radius ×1.2 and cooldown ×0.9, easier to sweep several movers at once, at the cost of a shorter cloud, shallower sleep and one more dose needed.
worldcombat.skill.sleeppowder.growth.1: From level %1$s the cloud radius is %2$s and the doses needed drop to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.sleeppowder.preference: On: radius ×0.8, duration ×1.25, sleep ×1.25 and one fewer dose needed, but cooldown ×1.15 — for sealing one small patch completely. Off (thin): radius ×1.2 and cooldown ×0.9, easier to sweep several movers at once, but a shorter cloud, shallower sleep and one more dose needed.
Beyond this distance the partner will not throw first but closes in; larger lets it drop a cloud from farther away.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to scatter powder; when off it only throws from where it already reaches.
